name: AtlProgress
purpose: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar. Renders the share of work completed for a task whose duration is measurable, or an indeterminate animation when it is not.

rules.statement: Reporting upload, download, or file-processing progress where bytes or items completed are known.
Showing form completion across multiple steps as a percentage.
Indicating an in-flight background operation with `indeterminate` when the total is unknown.
Visualising quota or capacity usage against a maximum.
Reserving the layout slot for content that has not loaded yet.
rules.useInstead: AtlSkeleton — sized to the missing content, not a generic bar.
AtlToast — transient confirmation belongs in a live region, not a progress bar.

checks.test: sets aria-valuenow to the current value
sets aria-valuenow to the clamped value
sets aria attributes from value and max
clamps values exceeding max to max
does not set aria-valuenow when indeterminate
omits aria-valuenow and aria-valuemax when indeterminate

tokens.name: --ui-color-danger
tokens.intent: Destructive action and error signal colour. Use for delete buttons and form errors.
constraints: Pair with text + icon — never rely on colour alone for state.
Do not use for decorative emphasis.
Pair foreground text with --ui-color-text-on-danger when used as a fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-primary
tokens.intent: Primary call-to-action colour and link text. Brand anchor on light backgrounds.
constraints: Must meet >=4.5:1 contrast against the surface it renders on.
Reserve for one primary action per view — do not stack two side-by-side.
Pair foreground text with --ui-color-text-on-primary when used as a fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-success
tokens.intent: Positive confirmation signal colour. Use for success buttons and confirmation icons.
constraints: Pair with text + icon — never rely on colour alone for state.
Do not use for decorative emphasis.
Pair foreground text with --ui-color-text-on-success when used as a fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-surface-sunken
tokens.intent: Recessed surface for input fields, code blocks, and inset containers.
constraints: Pair with --ui-color-text or --ui-color-text-muted only — never raw black/white.
Do not combine with elevation shadows — sunken surfaces should read as inset.

tokens.name: --ui-color-warning
tokens.intent: Caution signal colour. Use for warning alerts and pending states.
constraints: Pair with text + icon — never rely on colour alone for state.
Do not use for decorative emphasis.

tokens.name: --ui-ease-in-out
tokens.intent: Symmetrical easing curve. Use for elements moving across the screen.
constraints: Use --ui-ease-out for entrances, --ui-ease-in-out for movement, --ui-ease-spring for emphasised transitions.

tokens.name: --ui-font-family
tokens.intent: Default UI typeface stack. Instrument Sans first, with system fallbacks for offline / first-paint (ADR-0035).
constraints: Declare it once on each component root — not per rule, and not left to the app shell: a component that depends on the consumer applying it renders in the app's font while its neighbours render this one (measured; ADR-0049).
Use --ui-font-display for the one display line per surface; everything interactive stays on this stack.

tokens.name: --ui-line-height-tight
tokens.intent: Compact leading (1.25) for headings and single-line UI text.
constraints: Do not use for multi-line body copy — readability suffers.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-full
tokens.intent: Fully rounded (pill) shape. Use for avatar masks, status dots, and pill buttons.
constraints: Use on equal-sided elements (circles) or fixed-height pills — applied to rectangles it produces inconsistent corners.

tokens.name: --ui-transition-normal
tokens.intent: Composed transition shorthand: normal duration + ease-out. Default for interactive state changes.
constraints: Apply to the `transition` property with the property name (e.g. `background var(--ui-transition-normal)`).
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through its constituent --ui-duration-normal token.
